notes.note: ChooseWildMonIndex_Fishing switches only on SUPER_ROD; every other rod falls through with wildMonIndex 0, so it can only ever hook fishing slot 0.
With a lure active there is a 2-in-10 chance the slot is mirrored to 14 - index, which reaches indices 10-14 of a 10-slot table and reads past its end.
OW_TIME_OF_DAY_ENCOUNTERS is FALSE, so every map has exactly one encounter table set; time of day does not change what appears.

InitRoamer can only add SPECIES_LATIAS, SPECIES_LATIOS, and the only scripts that call it are data/scripts/players_house.inc, data/scripts/tv.inc - Hoenn scripts, so no roaming encounter exists in the Kanto scope.

entries.levelNote: the traded mon is created at the level of the Pokemon the player gives up (CreateInGameTradePokemonInternal reads GetLevelFromBoxMonExp of the offered mon), so it has no fixed level
